topic: A quick nutrition comparison before you order

featureClaims.claim: View restaurant menu-item details and nutrition information.
Compare restaurant meals using the available meal comparison tools.

hook: Before you order, compare this first
voiceover: Before you order, take a quick look at the menu details. Check total carbohydrates and serving size. When you compare meals, notice protein and fiber alongside carbohydrates. For packaged foods, check carbohydrates per serving and ingredient order. Use the restaurant's posted nutrition or the package label to verify what you see.

caption: A quick comparison can add helpful context before you order. Check serving size, carbohydrates, protein, and fiber, then verify official menu details.
